title: A federated learning backdoor defense method based on similarity filtering
assignee: Shenzhen Research Institute Of Nanjing University Of Aeronautics And Astronautics

pse.problem: Backdoor attacks on federated learning by contaminating dataset lead to a global model that behaves normally with benign samples but shows specified state with trigger samples.
pse.solution_function: Defends against backdoor attacks in federated learning by identifying and excluding malicious updates based on similarity filtering (cosine similarity, Euclidean distance, Manhattan distance, Mahalanobis distance) to maintain a secure global model.
pse.solution_structure: Involves multiple clients with their individual datasets, a global model for aggregation of updates, and possible dynamic indicator identification systems.
pse.solution_implementation: Updates are processed based on similarity functions (cosine similarity, Euclidean distance, Manhattan distance), malicious updates are identified and excluded or weighted dynamically to mitigate the backdoor effect.
pse.effect: Reduces vulnerability of federated learning to backdoor attacks by ensuring secure global model updates.
